title: Spelling CVC Words Worksheets | Kindergarten Phonics Practice with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: L.K.2d, RF.K.3

Give your learners extra practice with Spelling CVC Words! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Spell It!
  • Pick the Right Spelling
  • Match Words to Pictures
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Spell It!, Pick the Right Spelling, Match Words to Pictures), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
